decisions.reason: As a large expanding telecom firm with slack, management would likely keep this strategically important cloud contact centre service because it fits the hybrid-cloud, customer-oriented portfolio and there is no clear sign that performance has fallen far enough below aspiration to trigger withdrawal.

Because the call number routing platform is very close to the core connectivity offer, leverages existing network capabilities, and would likely be judged at least near aspiration relative to peers and past expectations, management would keep it.
